function: system (pp. 3-4): a learned SAC policy allocates ISAC sensing energy and AIGC generation steps (area 5), but the ISAC device has a single antenna, links are scalar SISO, and there is no RIS.
notes: Excluded as system. p. 3: "Assume a single-antenna ISAC transceiver device, which can switch between the sensing mode and communication mode". p. 4: the user rate is Ck = (B/K) log2(1 + gk Pc K/(delta^2 B)), where "gk is the channel gain, including large-scale path loss and small-scale Rayleigh fading", a scalar single-antenna link. No RIS appears anywhere. The earlier codes pass. The method is learned (p. 6: the DNN "should be trained to learn the policy mapping from user states to sensing energy and generating step actions"; SAC, p. 8). Sensing energy is a resource shared with communication energy (p. 5, C2; p. 8, Er = Emax minus the sensing energy), so the work learns a physical-layer ISAC resource decision jointly with an edge-computing one (generation steps), which passes above_phy and fits area 5. Communication energy is set by the ranking LP algorithm RCE (p. 8). Reviewer check: if per-user sensing-energy allocation were read as scheduling, above_phy (code 4) would come first. The PDF is arXiv 2508.12079v2 and matches the DOI: same title and authors as the Crossref record of 10.1109/TMC.2026.3652144.
